description: Register a consequential action for human approval BEFORE performing it. Returns a request id. The action is NOT executed by this server; status 'approved' does NOT authorize anything by itself. Right before acting, call consume_approval with the same id, the exact action text and the same operation/payload if you supplied them; proceed only on ok:true. Anything else means no (fail closed).

action.description: Precise description of the action you intend to take, e.g. 'send email to alice@example.com with subject X'

operation.description: Optional operation name a trusted executor must present, e.g. 'smtp.send' (A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : / -)

payload.description: Optional JSON payload the action will execute (at most 32768 bytes canonical). The human reviews it; consume must present an identical payload.

reason.description: Why this action is needed right now

requested_by.description: Identifier of the requesting agent or workflow (self-reported, not authenticated)

ttl_seconds.description: How long the request stays valid, pending or approved (default 1 hour)

name: request_approval
